Bulbs to plant now, and what to do with the last tomatoes

October garden notes

It is bulb season. Plant tulips about three times as deep as the bulb is tall, pointy end up. Daffodils are happy in grass and squirrels leave them alone.

Still have green tomatoes? Bring them indoors with a banana in a paper bag, or make chutney: our members' recipe is on the website.
